snippet.title: Giantess Game Unreal 5.5 Teaser - Girl Who Shrunk the Neighbors
snippet.description:
Add to your wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2822970/Girl_Who_Shrunk_the_Neighbors/

Set to release anytime in March 2025 (Estimate 21st - 30th)

Giantess shrink survival game made in Unreal Engine 5.5

New features:
- Option to play as a girl
- Zooming in and zooming out
- Ant vehicle to climb faster
- Low poly areas on giantess have been upgraded to highpoly

Reason for long release:
Unreal Engine was a complicated software to use at the start when switching from Unity. It took some time to learn. After the adaption, the project was finally able to make some progress. There's things in Unreal that could've been done faster in Unity such as collision for giantess and activating objects, but since Unreal looks better and doesn't have a bad reputation such as the install fee it was definitely worth it.

Music by Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio
